answer_1.quote: In the past few years, Text-To-Speech (TTS) models have made a lot of progress in synthesizing human-like speech.

answer_2.quote: We have used the following metrics for evaluating our model and the baseline. σ p : phoneme-level standard deviation of duration or pitch in a speech. ... Determinant: a determinant of the similarity matrix ...
automatic_metrics: σ_p (phoneme-level standard deviation of duration or pitch)
determinant of similarity matrix (using cosine similarity)

answer_4.quote: Via Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT), we assign ten testers living in the United States to a pair of audio samples ... and ask them to listen to audio samples and choose among three options: A: sample A has more varied prosody than sample B, Same: sample A and B are equally varied in prosody, B: the opposite of first option. ... testers are asked to give a score between 1 to 5 ... based on the sample's naturalness ... they are asked to focus on the prosody aspect of audio samples.
answer_4.guideline: For side-by-side evaluation: testers choose which sample has more varied prosody (rhythm or pitch). For MOS: testers rate naturalness on a scale of 1-5 with focus on prosody.
